hypothesis: A reusable erasure plan can preformat the exact dense GF8 coefficient schedule once and use the existing one-pass AVX2 multi-output kernel to beat the transform decoder for 1..63-byte shards with five through eight missing originals.

source_identity.note: The two post-benchmark commits alter the portable-ISA audit and delete unreferenced always-inline helpers; they do not alter the promoted routing, schedule, or arithmetic. The current Release benchmark retains the same 1391731-byte text size as the attested candidate.

implementation.plan_setup: The immutable decode plan stores at most sixteen tagged source coordinates and an 8-by-16 byte matrix of nonzero GF8 multiplier logs. Locator-built plans fill the common-order matrix before output-row copy-first canonicalization; the fallback compiler maps tagged sources in O(K*L), not O(K*K*L).
implementation.execution: The plan gathers K source pointers once and calls AVX2FF8LinearCombinationTiny for all L outputs. The backend handles exact 16/8/4/2/1-byte tails without reading rounded padding.
implementation.dispatcher: Reusable production plans select this route only for supported five-through-eight-loss cells at 1..63 bytes. B64..1023 remains on the measured transform route; at least 1024 bytes retains the established source-major direct route. Public one-shot tiny decode remains on the transform path because cold setup dominates.

full_matched_campaign.statistic: paired round log-ratio Student-t 95 percent interval

exact_main_amortized_by_reuse.semantics: Leopard main decode includes pattern setup on every call. Leopard2 is execution plus immutable plan setup divided by reuse. For logical sizes below 64 bytes, main processes a zero-padded 64-byte physical shard because the old API does not support exact tails.

reuse_1.interpretation: Cold reusable-plan construction loses to main. The public one-shot API therefore retains the transform route; callers expecting one execution should use one-shot decode.

same_executable_attribution.purpose: Remove compiler/link layout phase from the route comparison by using the exact candidate executable for both processes and --force-specialized only for the control process.

incremental_prior_production_screen.purpose: Compare the accepted candidate to the immediately preceding production commit rather than only to a compile-time selector.

k8_full_loss_layout_observation.interpretation: Both commits select the identical materialized transform route. The same-executable attribution above measures it at 1.0004x with no credible regression, identifying this cross-binary result as link-layout phase rather than a new runtime operation. Leopard2 still beats exact main by 2.1448x geometric mean for this excluded shape in the full campaign.

code_generation.budget_exception: The 960-byte excess is accepted because the target execution gain is 3.39x overall, every target cell clears 5 percent credibly, and the same-executable unchanged-path control is neutral.

strict_builds.cleanup: Clang exposed five transitive dead always-inline helpers in Leopard2BackendAVX2T8K8B1024.cpp; afdd206 removes them.

rejected_variants.candidate: Split five-through-eight output calls into Group4 plus Group1..4 to reduce stack spills
rejected_variants.reason: The split reread every source group and lost more memory/load work than it recovered from reduced register spills. Only K16/L8/B31 improved credibly. The prototype was reverted completely.

rejected_variants.candidate: Move the tiny schedule to the tail of leo2_decode_plan and short-circuit the direct-plan predicate
rejected_variants.reason: The attempted layout change worsened the excluded K8 full-loss transform screen. It was reverted completely; same-executable attribution was used to distinguish real work from cross-binary layout phase.

isolation_note: The campaign used the canonical build/timing lock, immutable read-only binaries, CPU6 child pinning, CPU22 sibling before/after gates, and CPU0 controller pinning. The temporary runner manually pinned the controller instead of using the release supervisor because unrelated same-user long-lived processes made the supervisor's process-affinity mutation inappropriate. Treat it as pinned, sibling-gated promotion evidence, not as a release-final pair-exclusion certificate.

commands.strict_build: cmake -S . -B STRICT -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DLEO2_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DLEO2_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF '-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror' && cmake --build STRICT --target leopard -j1
commands.candidate_benchmark: taskset -c 6 bench_leopard2 --k K --r R --profile high --field gf8 --backend avx2 --bytes BYTES --loss LOSSES --batch 1 --reuse REUSE --iterations 21 --warmup 5 --threads 1 --seed SEED --skip-legacy --retain-samples --report-decode-path --report-direct-executor --json FILE
commands.same_executable_control: Use the identical candidate command and executable with --force-specialized.
commands.exact_main_benchmark: taskset -c 6 leopard_main_benchmark --k K --r R --bytes max(64,BYTES) --logical-bytes BYTES --loss LOSSES --batch 1 --reuse REUSE --iterations 21 --warmup 5 --threads 1 --seed SEED --json FILE
